requirements.quote:
It is RECOMMENDED that
   implementations place limits on the total lifetime of such keying
   material
requirements.condition: new tickets can extend keying material originating from an initial non-PSK handshake
requirements.required_behavior: enforce a finite limit on the total lifetime of that keying material
requirements.forbidden_behavior: allowing ticket issuance to extend the keying material indefinitely
requirements.why_checkable: Ticket policy can be inspected for an effective finite lifetime cap.
